title: introduce-awaitable-stream-abstractions-and-session-sanity-across-py-ts-go
author: Evelyn Chen
ci_status: pass (one flaky linux-py job failed on first run, rerun succeeded)
description: Motivation: customers and internal adopters reported subtle UX mismatches between Python/TS/Go streaming helpers and credential/session lifecycles. This PR unifies an "awaitable stream" surface across the three SDKs, stabilizes session lease semantics for long-lived streams, harmonizes retry presets used by streaming transports, and bumps the SDK package versions. High level changes: 1) Python: add AsyncIteratorAdapter to present an awaitable streaming facade that supports async for, explicit aclose(), and a contextmanager helper (async with Client.stream_session(...)). This fixes edge cases where background reconnects leaked session handles. 2) TypeScript: introduce AsyncIterableStream<T> export and a small helper to interoperate with promise-based consumers; add typed drain() and cancel() helpers that mirror Python ergonomics. 3) Go: implement ContextSessionManager which ties session leases to context cancellation and exposes a compact StreamHandle with Close(ctx) that flushes prefetched tokens and heartbeats. 4) Retry and backoff: consolidate streaming retry presets into a shared config proto used by all SDKs and add a small shim for adaptive windowing under high-throughput workloads. 5) Tests & docs: add cross-language examples in examples/streaming/awaitables and end-to-end integration tests that exercise credential rotation during a stream. 6) Version bumps: python 0.10.0, typescript 2.3.0, go v1.7.1. Compatibility notes: API is additive; small naming changes to export names in TS are behind a compat alias to avoid breaking consumers. Changelog and migration notes included in release_notes. CI: initial run showed a flaky linux-py test related to event loop teardown; test was hardened and rerun. Merge: squash-and-merge after approvals.

release_notes: Added awaitable streaming helpers across Python/TypeScript/Go with unified session lease semantics and consolidated streaming retry presets. Python: AsyncIteratorAdapter and async contextmanager for streams. TypeScript: AsyncIterableStream export with cancel/drain helpers and compat alias for safe migration. Go: ContextSessionManager and StreamHandle.Close(ctx) which waits for heartbeat ack. Bumped SDKs: python 0.10.0, typescript 2.3.0, go v1.7.1. Tests: new cross-language integration tests and examples/streaming/awaitables included. Migration: mostly additive; TS export rename available via compat alias, see docs/migration/awaitable-streams.md for guidance.
